solutions.title: Recursive DFS accumulator
solutions.strategy: Carry the numeric prefix into each child and add the prefix only at leaves.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every tree node is visited once and does O(1) arithmetic.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack is bounded by tree height h, which is O(n) for a skewed tree.

solutions.title: Iterative DFS stack
solutions.strategy: Store each node with the value represented by the path that reaches it.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit stack holds one frontier path per active branch, O(h) for balanced traversal and O(n) in the worst skew.
